items.statement: Ekaterina opened her real estate company in a market where investors cannot properly own property due to visa requirements.

items.statement: The company communicated to agents that they would eventually get paid, but without a commitment on timing.

items.statement: The agents were told to continue closing deals with the promise of future payment that was uncertain.

items.quote: but you don't have a guarantee that they will pay you from the new ones as well.
items.statement: There was no guarantee that agents would be paid from new deals they generated, leading to an increased debt.

items.quote: she's going to be running that movement and that wave of the first investors, the first expats
items.statement: Ekaterina is seen as a leader in the real estate market by being among the first to attract international investors to Saudi Arabia.

overview: Transcript of a discussion about starting a real estate agency and the challenges faced with payment issues.
